modules.module_title: Prepare to carry out routine service or minor repair on Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand work to be carried out on Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)
place the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) on suitable platform according to nature of job to be performed
conduct visual inspection on Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) to lead technician to assess defects, such as: any external impact/bend/leak/incorrect level/wear & tear etc.
collect workshop tools/measuring devices/equipment required to carry out job on Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) and check their condition/calibration
wear PPE according to nature of job to be performed on the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)
report the malfunctions/repairs in Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) beyond own scope to the concerned person

modules.module_title: Assist lead technician in diagnosis or troubleshooting the faults on HCV

pcs.pc_description: take precautions to avoid damage to the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) and its components while working on various aggregates
conduct test drive of the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) to assist the lead technician in assessing the service/repair requirement or calibration/adjustments, if any
follow lead technician instructions to choose and use the appropriate device/equipment to inspect/test the Heavy Commercial Vehicle's (HCV) system/component performance to diagnose or defect faults
carry out inspection or test on mechanical and electrical systems of Heavy Commercial Vehicle's (HCV) according to lead technician instructions
interpret and compare results of diagnostic inspections/tests with Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) specifications or regulatory requirements
maintain the documentation related to inspections and troubleshooting performed on the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)
report the results to lead technician and seek assistance if further tests or inspections are required to conclude the diagnosis

modules.module_title: Perform routine service and minor repairs on HCV

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate tools, equipment, and consumables as per nature of job and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) recommended by the organisation
test the Heavy Commercial Vehicle's (HCV) electrical/electronic components performance wherever applicable as per OEM SOP
remove parts relevant to various mechanical aggregates of Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) and place them securely as specified by OEM
clean and condition dismantled mechanical and electrical components of Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) prior to assembly

perform minor repair/replacement/calibration on Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)systems such as: engine, multi-axle, differential, propeller shaft, mechanical/air suspension systems, air brakes & steering systems etc. including HVAC wherever applicable
refill/replace, as required quantity and appropriate grade of coolant engine oil, brake/steering fluid and lubricant in the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV) as per OEM guidelines
maintain the documentation related to servicing and minor repair performed on the Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)
check the performance of Heavy Commercial Vehicle (HCV)/aggregate post repair and report to lead technician/supervisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the Heavy Commercial Vehicle's (HCV) for the next procedure
dispose of materials such as used oils, coolant, old batteries, scrap of failed parts/aggregates as per organization’s policies
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed to the person concerned
